title: PlannerPlanIssue
description: One proposed (or confirmed) issue inside a `planner.plan-run`'s `issues` array (`youtrack/planner/src/backlog_planner/domain/planning.py`). This is the model-proposed shape, before any owner edit at confirm time.

key.description: A key unique within this plan, referenced by `parent`/`dependsOn`/`relatesTo` on sibling issues. Not the tracker's own issue id -- see `planner.plan-run.created` for that.

parent.description: The `key` of this issue's parent within the same plan, or `null`.

dependsOn.description: Keys of issues in the same plan this one depends on.

relatesTo.description: Keys of issues in the same plan this one relates to.
